effectiveFieldReplacements.before: The Clerks' Manual directs that if the movant has not already served copies of the notice per the distribution list by first class mail, the clerk does. The packet tells the movant how to serve and provides the certificate.
effectiveFieldReplacements.after: The Clerks' Manual directs that if the movant has not already served copies of the notice per the distribution list by first class mail, the clerk does. The required service-instructions component explains both service pathways and every applicable notice, recipient, timing, and proof-of-service obligation, including CR 5.03 where applicable. AOC-275.18's notification section and Copies to list identify notice/distribution controls; neither is a certificate or proof of completed service. The packet does not unconditionally promise a generated certificate or impose a universal affidavit. Applicable service documentation must describe actual acts by the actual server; the participant must not certify the clerk's actions. No proof obligation is waived.
AOC-275.18 notification-of-expungement-hearing section and printed Copies to distribution list (notice/distribution controls, not proof of completed service)
